description: Remove ONE attachment from an existing backlog item by its id or stored/original file name, then read the item's attachments back to confirm it is gone. Use it to undo a wrong upload.

attachment.description: Attachment id, or its original/stored file name.

entityType.description: Which backlog item the attachment belongs to.

itemId.description: Item id or business key (EP-66, FT-266, US-1326, DE-75).

name: attachment_delete
title: Remove an attachment from an epic, feature, user story or defect (SimplifyQA)
